title: HSK 1.13 · 衣服, 鸡蛋, 牛奶, 星期天, 不客气
focus: 毛 · 八 · 七 · 菜 · 衣服 · 饿 · 树 · 慢 · 茶 · 九 · 妹妹 · 贵 · 知识 · 页 · 弟弟 · 百 · 明年 · 妹 · 奶 · 奶奶 · 牛奶 · 爷爷 · 新年 · 鸡蛋 · 零 · 午饭 · 弟 · 早饭 · 星期天 · 看病 · 前天 · 渴 · 米饭 · 星期日 · 不客气 · 前边 · 网友 · 半年
body:
Family, food, numbers and the calendar. The meal words share 饭, the time words share 年 and 天, and the family words share the 女 radical.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 饭 | fàn | meal (饣 + 反) | 午饭, 早饭, 米饭 |
| 年 | nián | year | 明年, 新年, 半年 |
| 天 | tiān | day | 星期天, 前天 |
| 前 | qián | before; front | 前天, 前边 |
| 星期 | xīngqī | week | 星期天, 星期日 |
| 奶 | nǎi | milk; grandma (女 + 乃) | 奶奶, 牛奶 |
| 妹 / 弟 | mèi / dì | younger sister / brother | 妹妹, 弟弟 |
| 女 | nǚ | woman (radical) | 妹, 奶 |

## Watch out

- 渴 kě (thirsty) has 氵 water; 喝 hē (drink) has 口 mouth. Same right side 曷.
- 毛 vs 手: 毛's last stroke hooks right; 手's vertical hooks left.
- 妹 has 未 (top line short); 末 mò has the top line long.
- 午 wǔ (noon) vs 牛 niú (cow): in 牛 the vertical pokes through the top.
- 八 bā vs 人 rén vs 入 rù: 八's two strokes don't touch.

cards.Example: 这个三块五毛。 zhège sān kuài wǔ máo: This is three fifty.
cards.Notes: Picture of a hair or feather. Lookalike: 手 shǒu hand (毛 hooks right at the bottom; 手 hooks left)

cards.Example: 我八点上班。 wǒ bā diǎn shàngbān: I start work at eight.
cards.Notes: Two strokes parting. Lookalikes: 人 rén and 入 rù, whose strokes touch

cards.Example: 一个星期有七天。 yí ge xīngqī yǒu qī tiān: A week has seven days.
cards.Notes: A horizontal crossed by a hooked vertical. Lookalike: 匕 bǐ (spoon), where nothing crosses

cards.Example: 这个菜是我妈妈做的。 zhège cài shì wǒ māma zuò de: My mom made this dish.
cards.Notes: 艹 plant on top + 采 cǎi for the sound

cards.Example: 我去买衣服。 wǒ qù mǎi yīfu: I'm going to buy clothes.
cards.Notes: 衣 garment (picture of a robe's collar) + 服 clothing = clothes. 服 is toneless fu here

cards.Example: 我饿死了。 wǒ è sǐ le: I'm starving.
cards.Notes: 饣 food + 我 wǒ for the sound

cards.Example: 他在树下睡觉。 tā zài shù xià shuìjiào: He's sleeping under the tree.
cards.Notes: 木 tree + 对 duì

cards.Example: 请说慢一点儿。 qǐng shuō màn yìdiǎnr: Please speak more slowly.
cards.Notes: 忄 heart + 曼 màn for the sound. Opposite: 快 (also 忄)

cards.Example: 爷爷每天都喝茶。 yéye měitiān dōu hē chá: Grandpa drinks tea every day.
cards.Notes: 艹 leaves on top, 木 a bush at the bottom

cards.Example: 现在九点。 xiànzài jiǔ diǎn: It's nine o'clock.
cards.Notes: ノ then a stroke that curls right. Lookalikes: 力 lì (strength), 丸 wán

cards.Example: 她是我妹妹。 tā shì wǒ mèimei: She's my little sister.
cards.Notes: 妹 = 女 + 未 wèi; 未 vs 末 (mò): in 末 the top stroke is longer

cards.Example: 这个太贵了。 zhège tài guì le: This is too expensive.
cards.Notes: 贝 shell (ancient money) at the bottom. Money words often have 贝. Opposite: 便宜

cards.Example: 书里有很多知识。 shū li yǒu hěn duō zhīshi: Books hold lots of knowledge.
cards.Notes: 知 know (矢 arrow + 口) + 识 recognize (讠 + 只 for the sound) = knowing and recognizing

cards.Example: 请看第十页。 qǐng kàn dì-shí yè: Please look at page ten.
cards.Notes: Originally a picture of a head; as a radical it marks head words (题, 颜, 顶)

cards.Example: 弟弟睡觉了。 dìdi shuìjiào le: Little brother's asleep.
cards.Notes: 弟 vs 第 (dì, used for 'number ...'): 第 has 竹 bamboo on top

cards.Example: 这个一百块。 zhège yìbǎi kuài: This is a hundred yuan.
cards.Notes: 一 one + 白 bái for the sound. Lookalike: 白 (no line on top)

cards.Example: 明年我去中国。 míngnián wǒ qù Zhōngguó: I'm going to China next year.
cards.Notes: 明 bright, next + 年 year = next year. Like 明天

cards.Example: 这是我妹。 zhè shì wǒ mèi: This is my little sister.
cards.Notes: 女 woman + 未 wèi for the sound. 未 (short top line) vs 末 mò (long top line)

cards.Example: 你要奶吗？ nǐ yào nǎi ma: Do you want milk?
cards.Notes: 女 woman + 乃 nǎi for the sound

cards.Example: 奶奶做饭了。 nǎinai zuòfàn le: Grandma's made food.
cards.Notes: 奶 = 女 woman + 乃 nǎi, which gives the exact sound

cards.Example: 我每天喝牛奶。 wǒ měitiān hē niúnǎi: I drink milk every day.
cards.Notes: 牛 cow + 奶 milk. 牛 vs 午: the vertical of 牛 pokes through the top

cards.Example: 爷爷和奶奶都在家。 yéye hé nǎinai dōu zài jiā: Grandpa and Grandma are both home.
cards.Notes: 父 father on top, like 爸

cards.Example: 新年快乐！ xīnnián kuàilè: Happy New Year!
cards.Notes: 新 new (斤 axe on the right: freshly cut wood) + 年 year

cards.Example: 我要两个鸡蛋。 wǒ yào liǎng ge jīdàn: I'd like two eggs.
cards.Notes: 鸡 chicken (又 + 鸟 bird) + 蛋 egg (虫 at the bottom) = chicken egg

cards.Example: 现在零下五度。 xiànzài língxià wǔ dù: It's five below zero.
cards.Notes: ⻗ rain + 令 lìng for the sound: first meant raindrops falling, then 'fractional, zero'

cards.Example: 我们一起吃午饭吧。 wǒmen yìqǐ chī wǔfàn ba: Let's have lunch together.
cards.Notes: 午 noon + 饭 meal. 午 vs 牛: 午's vertical doesn't poke through

cards.Example: 我弟十岁。 wǒ dì shí suì: My little brother is ten.
cards.Notes: 丷 on top of a 弓-like body with a ノ; also the sound part of 第 dì

cards.Example: 你吃早饭了吗？ nǐ chī zǎofàn le ma: Have you had breakfast?
cards.Notes: 早 early (日 sun over 十) + 饭 meal = morning meal

cards.Example: 星期天我不上班。 xīngqītiān wǒ bú shàngbān: I don't work on Sundays.
cards.Notes: 星期 week (星 star + 期 period) + 天 day = the week's day. Same as 星期日

cards.Example: 我下午去看病。 wǒ xiàwǔ qù kànbìng: I'm seeing a doctor this afternoon.
cards.Notes: 看 look at + 病 illness (疒 sickbed) = have an illness looked at; also a doctor seeing patients

cards.Example: 前天我去北京了。 qiántiān wǒ qù Běijīng le: I went to Beijing the day before yesterday.
cards.Notes: 前 before + 天 day. Ladder: 前天, 昨天, 今天, 明天, 后天

cards.Example: 我渴了，想喝水。 wǒ kě le, xiǎng hē shuǐ: I'm thirsty, I want water.
cards.Notes: 氵 water + 曷 for the sound. Lookalike: 喝 hē (drink) has 口 instead

cards.Example: 我吃米饭。 wǒ chī mǐfàn: I'll have rice.
cards.Notes: 米 looks like rice grains around a cross; 米 vs 来 (lái), which has an extra stroke on top

cards.Example: 星期日你有空吗？ xīngqīrì nǐ yǒu kòng ma: Are you free on Sunday?
cards.Notes: 星期 week + 日 day = Sunday; a bit more formal than 星期天

cards.Example: 谢谢！不客气。 xièxie! bú kèqi: Thanks! You're welcome.
cards.Notes: 不 not + 客气 polite (客 guest + 气 air) = no need for guest manners. 不 is bú before a 4th tone

cards.Example: 前边有个商店。 qiánbian yǒu ge shāngdiàn: There's a shop up ahead.
cards.Notes: 前 front + 边 side. Opposite: 后边

cards.Example: 我们是网友。 wǒmen shì wǎngyǒu: We're online friends.
cards.Notes: 网 net (picture of a net) + 友 friend = net friend

cards.Example: 我学了半年汉语。 wǒ xuéle bànnián Hànyǔ: I've studied Chinese for half a year.
cards.Notes: 半 half + 年 year
